content: Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ arabhɨrɨkɨra Peetero

Kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Kaisaariya, aarɨmu ʉmʉkʉrʉ wa riribhita rya abhasirikarɨ, iriina ryazɨ Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ. Aarɨ imiiririirɨ riribhita rya abhasirikarɨ igana rɨmwɨ, kurwa mwiribhita rikʉrʉ rya abhasirikarɨ rɨnʉ rikubhirikirwa Riribhita ryi Ikiitaariya.
Aarɨ moronge na arasengera Mungu, hamwɨmwɨ na abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bha yɨɨka waazɨ, aarɨ arasabha Mungu ibhaga ryʉsi. Hamwɨmwɨ na gayo, aarɨ arasakirya abhahabhɨ bhɨ Ɨkɨyaahudi.
Rusikʉ rʉmwɨ zɨɨsa kenda umwise, Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ akarora ʉbhʉrʉri. Kʉbhʉrʉri bhuyo, akarora habhwɨrʉ maraika wa Mungu aramuhwarʉkɨra na kʉmʉbhɨrɨkɨra, “Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ!”

Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ akarora maraika wuyo akʉʉbhaha, akamubhuurya, “Kɨgʉrʉkɨ, ʉmʉkʉrʉ waanɨ?” Maraika wuyo akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Mungu igwirɨ amasabhi gaazʉ ni ibhimweso bhyazʉ, bhyʉsi bhihikirɨ kwa Mungu na bhɨrabha ubhuhiiti bhwazɨ.
Nangʉ tʉma abhaatʉ kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yoopa, bhabhɨrɨkɨrɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ, iriina ryazɨ Simʉʉni, iriina ɨrɨndɨ, arabhirikirwa Peetero.
Ariikara wa Simʉʉni yɨɨka, ʉmʉkʉri wa amaseero, inyumba yaazɨ ɨrɨ haguhɨ nɨ ɨnyanza.”
Hanʉ maraika aamarirɨ kʉgambana na Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ gayo, akarweho. Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ akabhɨrɨkɨra abhahocha bhabhɨrɨ bha yɨɨka, nu umusirikarɨ wʉmwɨ, wʉnʉ aarɨ ʉmʉsakirya, wʉʉsi aarɨ ariigwa Mungu.
Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ akabhabhʉʉrɨra gʉʉsi ganʉ gakʉriibhwɨ, akʉmara akabhatʉma bhajɨ Yoopa.
Peetero ararora ʉbhʉrʉri
Urusikʉ rwa kabhɨrɨ ɨsa isaasabha umwise, hanʉ abhaatʉ bhatatʉ bhayo bhaarɨ haguhɨ nʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yoopa, Peetero akatiira kʉkɨsara chi inyumba
kosengera Mungu.
Ribhaga riyo akiigwa ɨnzara, akiigomba kurya. Ribhaga rɨnʉ ibhyakurya bhyarɨ bhɨraterekwa, akarora ʉbhʉrʉri.
Kʉbhʉrʉri bhuyo, akarora risaarʉ ryarɨ ryigukirɨ, ne ekegero nchu umwenda ʉmʉkʉrʉ gugwatirwɨ zesonga zaku inyɨ, zɨkahiringitibhwa haasɨ.
Mumwenda guyo, bhyarɨ bhirimu ibhityɨnyi bhya teemwa zʉʉsi, ibhityɨnyi bhya amagʉrʉ ane, ibhityɨnyi bhɨnʉ bhekogendera zɨnda ni ibhinyunyi bhyi igʉrʉ.
Akʉmara Peetero akiigwa riraka, rɨramʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Peetero, imɨɨrɨra, ʉsɨnzɨ, uryɨ!”
Peetero akamʉgarukirya, “Zɨyi, Ʉmʉkʉrʉ! Nɨkɨɨrɨ kurya ibhyakurya bhyʉbhyʉsi bhyi imigirʉ!”
Peetero akiigwa riraka riyo rwa kabhɨrɨ, “Ʉtabhɨbhɨrɨkɨra kʉbha bhya kobhengya, ebhegero bhɨnʉ Mungu abhɨngukiryɨ.”
Ringʼana riyo rɨkakorwa manga atatʉ, neho umwenda gurya gʉkagarukibhwa mwisaarʉ.
Hanʉ Peetero aarɨ ariibhuurya igʉrʉ we enzobhooro yʉ ʉbhʉrʉri bhuyo, abhaatʉ bhatatʉ bhanʉ bhaatumirwɨ na Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ bhakahika kunyumba ya Simʉʉni ʉmʉkʉri wa amaseero, bhakiimɨɨrɨra kukisikʉ.
Bhakabhɨrɨkɨra na kubhuurya, arɨɨbhɨ kʉna mugini wʉnʉ akubhirikirwa Simʉʉni, iriina ɨrɨndɨ Peetero.
Hanʉ Peetero aarɨ akɨɨrɨ arakaja kwiseega igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉrʉri bhuyo, Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ɨkamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Itegeerera! Bharɨ hanʉ abhaatʉ bhatatʉ bharakomohya.
Hiringita uhiranɨ nabhʉ, ʉtabha na rʉhaho, kʉ kʉbha inyɨ niinyɨ nɨbhatumirɨ kwa naawɨ.”
Peetero akiika haasɨ, hanʉ aabhahikiirɨ, akabhʉʉrɨra abhaatʉ bhayo, “Inyɨ niinyɨ mokomohya. Nɨ kwakɨ mwizirɨ?”

Bhakamʉgarukirya, “Tutumirwɨ nʉ ʉmʉkʉrʉ wa abhasirikarɨ, iriina ryazɨ Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ. Ewe nɨ‑mʉʉtʉ we eheene na arasengera Mungu, wʉʉsi arakumibhwa na Abhayaahudi bhʉʉsi kʉbha nɨ‑mʉʉtʉ mʉzʉmu. Akabhuurirwa na maraika ʉmʉrɨndu, akuginihyɨ ɨwaazɨ korereke iitegeerere amangʼana ganʉ ʉraamʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ.”

Akʉmara Peetero akabhasikirya munyumba, bhabhɨ abhagini bhaazɨ. Peetero araja kwa Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ Tabhʉʉri waho, Peetero na abhaatʉ bhatatʉ bharya bhakatanga orogendo rwabhʉ, hamwɨmwɨ na abhiisirirya bhorebhe kurwa Yoopa.
Urusikʉ rwa kabhɨrɨ, bhakahika kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Kaisaariya, bhakaja wa Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ yɨɨka. Ribhaga riyo Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ aarɨ abhiringirɨ abhahiiri bhaazɨ, hamwɨmwɨ na abhasaani bhaazɨ, bharamʉrɨnda Peetero.
Hanʉ Peetero aarɨ arasikɨra, Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ akamʉsʉngʼaana, akahigama mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwazɨ na kwihiinya haasɨ korereke amosengere.
Nawe Peetero akamogororocha, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Imɨɨrɨra! Inyʉʉsi nɨ‑mʉʉtʉ ncha naawɨ!”
Akʉmara Peetero na Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ bhakasikɨra munyumba, bharagambana, bhakabhona abhaatʉ bhaaru bhiibhiringirɨ muyo.

Peetero akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Imwɨ mwɨzɨ bhwaheene kʉbha, imigirʉ jɨtʉ Abhayaahudi gɨratorecha kwisanja na abhaatʉ bha mubhyarʉ ɨbhɨndɨ nʉʉrʉ kʉbhataarɨra. Nawe Mungu andɨkiryɨ kʉbha, nitiiseega kʉbha, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi nɨ‑wa migirʉ na atakwenderwa.
Riyo neryo rigiriryɨ niizirɨ, hanʉ mumbirikiirɨ nɨtatitiikɨɨnɨ. Mmbe! Nɨrabhabhuurya ni‑ngʼanakɨ rɨnʉ mumbirikiriirɨ?”

Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Zisikʉ isatʉ zɨnʉ zihitirɨ zɨɨsa ncha zɨnʉzɨnʉ zɨɨsa kenda umwise, naarɨ munyumba nɨrasabha Mungu. Rogendo rʉmwɨ, nɨkarora ʉmʉʉtʉ imiiriirɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwanɨ, ibhʉhirɨ zengebho zɨnʉ zɨkʉbharya.
Akambʉʉrɨra, ‘Kʉrʉnɨriyʉ, amasabhi gaazʉ ni ibhimweso bhyazʉ bhyʉsi bhihikirɨ kwa Mungu na bhɨrabha Ubhuhiiti bhwazɨ.
Nangʉ tʉma abhaatʉ bhajɨ kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yoopa, bhabhɨrɨkɨrɨ Simʉʉni wʉnʉ akubhirikirwa Peetero. Ariikara wa Simʉʉni ʉmʉkʉri wa amaseero, wʉnʉ inyumba yaazɨ ɨrɨ haguhɨ nɨ ɨnyanza.’
Nɨkatʉma abhaatʉ bhaazɨ bhakʉbhɨrɨkɨrɨ, ʉkʉrirɨ bhwaheene kuuza. Nangʉ itwʉsi tʉrɨ hanʉ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu, korereke twitegeerere ɨngʼana yʉʉsi yɨnʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ akutumirɨ ʉtʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ.”
Neho Peetero akatanga kʉgamba, “Nangʉ nʉbhʉʉrirɨ kʉbha nɨ‑maheene, Mungu ataana kɨmbʉrʉʉri kʉbhaatʉ!
Nawe abhaatʉ bhi ibhyarʉ bhyʉsi bhanʉ bhakomosengera na kokora eheene mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwazɨ, bhahiisiriribhwa neewe.
Imubheene mwɨzɨ amangʼana ganʉ Mungu abhahiriirɨ Abhiiziraɨri. Akabharwazɨra Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu korereke bhabhɨ no omorembe na Mungu kʉnzɨra ya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ. Yɨɨsu wuyo newe Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wa abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi.
Mwɨzɨ amangʼana ganʉ gakʉriibhwɨ kʉʉsɨ yʉʉsi ya Yudeya, kwɨma Gariraaya hanʉ Yoohana aamarirɨ kurwazɨra abhaatʉ kʉbha bhabhatiizwɨ.

Naatu mwɨzɨ kʉbha, Mungu akarobhora Yɨɨsu wa Nazarɨɨti kwa komoha Ekoro Ɨndɨndu nʉ ʉbhʉnaja. Yɨɨsu akaja ɨnʉ ni irya, arakora amazʉmu na kohorya bhanʉ bhʉʉsi bhaarɨ bharanyaakibhwa na zinguru za Shɨtaani, kʉ kʉbha Mungu aarɨ hamwɨmwɨ neewe.
“Itwɨ nɨ‑bhamɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bha amangʼana gʉʉsi ganʉ Yɨɨsu aakʉrirɨ kʉʉsɨ ya Abhayaahudi na Yɨrusarɨɨmu. Abhaatʉ bhakamwita kʉ kʉmʉbhamba kʉmʉsarabha,
nawe urusikʉ rwa katatʉ, Mungu akamuryʉra, akamwerekenʼya kʉbhaatʉ.

Atarʉrɨkɨɨnɨ kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi, kuruushaku kʉbhanʉ Mungu aarɨ amarirɨ korobhora kʉbha abhamɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri. Abhamɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhayo ni‑twɨ, tʉkamorora, tʉkarya na kunywa hamwɨmwɨ neewe hanʉ aryukirɨ kurwa mʉbhaku.
Akatuswaja kurwazɨra abhaatʉ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu, na komenyeekererya kʉbha, umwene newe arʉbhwɨrwɨ na Mungu, abhɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ ya abhahʉru na abhaku.
Igʉrʉ waazɨ, abharʉʉtɨrɨri bhʉʉsi bhakagamba kʉbha, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ ariimwisiriryɨ arabheererwa ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwazɨ kʉnzɨra yi iriina ryazɨ.”
Hanʉ Peetero aarɨ aragamba amangʼana gayo, Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ɨkabhiikɨra bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhaarɨ bharamwitegeerera.
Abhayaahudi abhiisirirya
bhakaaza na Peetero, bhakarʉgʉʉra bhʉkʉngʼu, korora kʉbha Mungu abhiitiriirɨ abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatarɨ Abhayaahudi Ekoro Ɨndɨndu.
Bhakamenya kʉ kʉbha bhakiigwa abhaatʉ bhayo bharagamba kʉbhɨgambʉ bhyaru bhyaru, bharamukumya Mungu. Neho Peetero akabhuga,
“Abhaatʉ bhayo bhabhwɨnɨ Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, chɨmbu itwɨ twabhwɨnɨ. Heene areho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kʉbharecha abhaatʉ bhayo bhatabhatiizwa kwa amanzi?”
Akʉmara Peetero akabhaswaja bhabhatiizwɨ kuriina rya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ. Neho bhakasabha Peetero kwikara kwa sikʉ bhorebhe.

footnotes.text: Abhayaahudi bhaarɨ bharasereeta zinyumba zaabhʉ kwa kwara ibhisha igʉrʉ na kobhoha zindigi na kʉkanda no obhototo. Kiyo necho charɨ ɨkɨsara kɨnʉ bhaarɨ bhakwoyeerera.
Peetero aragarʉkɨra imigirʉ jɨ Ɨkɨyaahudi gɨnʉ gikwanga ibhyakurya bhyi imigirʉ. Rora Abharaawi 11.
Abhayaahudi abhiisirirya kuKigiriki nɨ‑bhanʉ bhasaarirwɨ, bhanʉ bhamwisiriiryɨ Kiriisitʉ.
